Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:55754
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8712 of 2024
Applicant :- Ranjit

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Suyesh Pradhan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

entities.text: State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3.

The FIR in question was lodged alleging that on 25.04.2024, the applicant came to the home of the victim at about 2.30 PM and when the daughter of the informant aged about 10 years was alone,
the applicant started fighting with her and abusing her.

It was further stated that when the father came back, the victim informed that the applicant had opened her clothes and was trying to commit wrong on her and as she raised hue and cry, the applicant ran away.

In the statement under Section Ranjit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191456082/
1 161 Cr.P.C., the victim once again stated that the applicant had tried to open her clothes and when she shouted, she was slapped and thereafter her father came and the applicant ran away.

entities.text: Section Ranjit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text: In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim stated for the first time that wrong was committed on her.
The FIR in question was lodged on 06.05.2024 with regard to the incident which allegedly took place on 25.04.2024.
The medical on record naturally does not corroborate the allegation as the same was done on 24.05.2024.
The tentative age of the victim is around 13 years.

4. The counsel for the applicant draws my attention to a report filed against the applicant under Section 107/116 Cr.P.C., in which it was alleged that the applicant had started a fight and there was an apprehension of breach of peace.
The said application was given on 24.08.2024.
5. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the earlier application given against the applicant by the same informant and there being no material to corroborate the allegation of rape as alleged only in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. coupled with the fact that there is an inordinate delay in lodging the FIR, a clear case for bail is made out, the applicant who is in custody since 05.06.2024 and has no criminal history is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Ranjit be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 153 of 2024, under Sections 323, 504, 506, 376(AB) IPC, Section 3(2)5 SC/ST Act and Section 5(M)/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Sadarpur, District Sitapur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.8.2024/Arun  Ranjit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191456082/
